name: Le Bristol Paris
address: 112 Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore, 75008 Paris, France
description:
Le Bristol Paris is an Oetker Collection hotel in central Paris, with on-site gardens and a rooftop pool overlooking Montmartre and the Eiffel Tower.
The property has a pool, parking, room service, multiple Michelin-starred restaurants, an in-house chocolate factory, a bakery with its own flour mill, and a wine-tasting cave.
Dining is led by chef Eric Frechon at three-Michelin-starred Epicure, in his 20th year at the property; the hotel cat Fa-Raon has his own apartment decorated by graffiti artist Renk.

The backdrop features the grand, multi-story exterior of the hotel building, adorned with many windows and shutters, complemented by lush green walls and mature trees.

A bright and spacious hotel gym featuring modern exercise equipment.
